items.title: Intel-backed auto-overclocking tool Hypertune optimizes individual systems, not test profiles — tool claims FPS improvement of up to 60% on Intel-based systems
items.description: Hypertune is an automated overclocking tool built on top of Intel's Extreme Tuning Utility (XTU) SDK and built in collaboration with engineers at Intel.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 4 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Following an early access period that included over 60,000 participants, auto-overclocking tool Hypertune has released its Gaming Performance Engineering platform, which is built on top of Intel's Extreme Tuning Utility (XTU) SDK and developed in partnership with Intel. The company claims the utility can boost frame rates by up to 60%, though you shouldn't expect that as the norm. The tool includes automated CPU and GPU overclocking, as well as customizable Windows features, network optimization, and game-specific optimizations.Go deeper with TH Premium: CPU (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Intel VP Robert Hallock sets Nova Lake expectations, teases return to Raptor Lake for DDR4 platformsCPU scaling with DLSSIntel's one-two punch plan in desktop CPUs is taking shapeBenchmarking AMD's BC-250, offering Steam Machine-like performance at half the priceAMD splits Zen 7 into three EPYC families for 2028 and starts selling server CPUs by the agent Hypertune partnered with Intel to build the tool, which the company says "evaluates each supported system individually" before optimizing rather than relying on generalized profiles. In its press release, Hypertune says it collaborated with famed overclocker SkatterBencher (Pieter Plaisier) to refine the software. We've reached out to Plaisier to confirm their involvement.Automated tuning programs usually don't work as well as advertised, and we haven't had the chance to test Hypertune ourselves yet. Especially on more recent hardware, expect performance gains to be minor. Hypertune shared some of its internal benchmarks to back up the claim, showcasing the actual test systems it used, the numbers it gathered, and what each step of Hypertune contributed to the performance increase.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: (Image credit: Hypertune)Hypertune tested two systems: one with a Core Ultra 9 285K and an RTX 5090, and another with a Core i7-14700K and an RTX 3080. For the 285K system, the team saw an 18.9% improvement in Homeworld 3 and a 28.2% improvement in Tomb Raider. For the 14700K system, the boost was up to 9.8% in Rainbow Six Siege and 4.3% in Marvel Rivals. Notably, these results are with Hypertune's Game Hub disabled. Game Hub automatically applies a graphics settings profile to select games, leading to massive increases in performance. Naturally, tweaking your own graphics settings in the same way leads to the same result. You may like Overclocker updates Hydra overclocking tool with VRAM and power limit controls for RTX 50-series GPUs Benchmarking 31 different CPUs in Onimusha: Way of the Sword Introducing Bench 2.0 — a revamped benchmark analyzer, exclusively for Tom's Hardware Premium subscribers (Image credit: Hypertune)In Homeworld 3, you can see how each step in the process impacted performance, with CPU tunning contributing the single biggest increase in performance. As shown by Marvel Rivals in Hypertune's data, some games will see little to no benefit from Hypertune, though select titles with certain hardware may see a significant performance increase. In this case, the Core Ultra 9 285K has plenty of room for overclocking, and Homeworld 3 is particularly sensitive to the CPU, so the uplift makes sense. (Image credit: Hypertune)Elsewhere, the gains aren't as pronounced. In Rainbow Six Siege, you can see that Hypertune contributed about a 9.8% jump in performance, though the vast majority of the improvement comes through Game Hub, where Hypertune changes in-game settings.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsIn a press release, Hypertune founder Austin Copeland wrote that the team was "not trying to build a tool for overclockers," suggesting it's aimed toward users who may not know about specific settings (i.e., the Balanced power plan on dual-CCD X3D CPUs, or HAGS for DLSS Frame Generation). Copeland was previously a coach for eSports organization TSM, coaching Valorant teams under the name "Apex." (Image credit: Hypertune)Hypertune works through Intel's XTU SDK, and the company says its optimizations are non-destructive and fully reversible. The software is mainly targeted toward competitive titles (naturally, given Copeland's background), but it can apply optimizations globally across the system. Hypertune says it's safe to use with anti-cheat software, including Riot Vanguard, Easy Anti-Cheat, and BattlEye.Although there are plenty of free tools that claim to optimize your system, Hypertune isn't among them. It's a subscription service, available for either $9.99 per month or $59.99 per year. In addition to software, Hypertune offers its "expert tuning" service for $80, where a technician will remote into your machine and manually tune it. On the subscription front, Hypertune says it offers a 7-day free trial. However, the subscription bills immediately, and we weren't able to find any offers for a free 7-day trial.Hypertune looks like one of the more robust automated overclocking tools we've seen, but it's worth highlighting that, in most cases, these tools don't do anything you can't accomplish yourself. If you're looking for a starting point, make sure to read our guides on how to overclock your graphics card and how to overclock your CPU. items.titleZh: 英特尔支持的自动超频工具Hypertune优化的是个体系统而非测试配置——该工具声称在基于英特尔的系统上帧率提升可达60%
items.descriptionZh:
经过为期数万用户参与的早期测试阶段，自动超频工具Hypertune正式发布了其“游戏性能调优平台”。该平台基于英特尔Extreme Tuning Utility（XTU）软件开发套件构建，并与英特尔合作推出。官方宣称该工具最高可将游戏帧率提升多达60%，但实际提升幅度远达不到这一数字，不应被视作普遍现象。工具集成了自动CPU与GPU超频、Windows系统功能定制、网络优化以及针对特定游戏的调优配置。

Hypertune的核心特点在于其宣称的“个性化评估”机制——不是套用通用配置文件，而是先对每一台受支持的电脑进行单独评估，再生成优化方案。在开发过程中，Hypertune与知名超频玩家SkatterBencher（Pieter Plaisier）进行了合作，公司称其参与了软件打磨；不过媒体联系Plaisier求证时尚未得到确认。

为验证效果，Hypertune公开了内部测试数据。测试平台包括一套搭载Core Ultra 9 285K处理器与RTX 5090显卡的系统，以及一套搭载Core i7-14700K与RTX 3080显卡的系统。在关闭其“Game Hub”功能的情况下，前一套系统在《家园3》中获得了18.9%的帧率提升，《古墓丽影》提升达28.2%；后一套系统在《彩虹六号：围攻》中提升约9.8%，《漫威争锋》则仅提高4.3%。其中Game Hub是Hypertune的一项额外功能，会为部分游戏自动套用合适的画面设置档，从而带来更大幅度的性能提升——这与用户自行降低画质设置的效果本质上相同。

以《家园3》为例，逐项分析显示CPU调优所贡献的性能增幅最大。但Hypertune自己的数据也表明，像《漫威争锋》这类游戏几乎无法从中获益，只有特定游戏搭配特定硬件、且硬件本身留有充足超频空间时，才会出现显著提升。例如Core Ultra 9 285K超频潜力较大，而《家园3》又对CPU性能很敏感，因此获得了明显收益。在其他游戏中，提升幅度相对有限，且多数增益来自Game Hub对游戏内设置的改动。

Hypertune创始人Austin Copeland在新闻稿中明确表示：“我们并不打算为超频发烧友打造工具。”他之前是电竞组织TSM的Valorant战队教练，化名“Apex”。这一背景说明工具瞄准的是普通玩家——他们可能不熟悉“双CCD X3D CPU的平衡电源计划”或“DLSS帧生成所需的硬件加速GPU调度（HAGS）”这类细节。Hypertune通过Intel XTU SDK工作，官方声称所有优化都是非破坏性的、可完全逆转。软件主要面向竞技类游戏，但也可以将优化全局应用到整个系统。同时它宣称与主流反作弊系统兼容，包括Riot Vanguard、Easy Anti-Cheat及BattlEye。

虽然市面上有许多标榜系统优化的免费工具，但Hypertune不是。它采用订阅制，价格分别为每月9.99美元或每年59.99美元。此外还提供80美元的“专家调优”服务，由技术人员远程连接用户的电脑进行手动调校。订阅方面，Hypertune声称提供7天免费试用，但媒体指出其订阅会立即扣费，且并未找到真正免费试用的入口。

从目前的报道来看，Hypertune是市面上较为完善的自动超频工具之一，但值得注意的是，在多数情况下这类工具所做的事，并不能超越用户手动操作所能实现的效果。如果你想自行尝试，更可靠的办法是参考相关教程自己动手超频显卡和CPU。对于是否值得订阅，汤姆硬件网认为仍需谨慎对待，尤其是考虑到自动调优工具往往宣传效果优于实际表现，而最新硬件的性能提升空间可能相当有限。

items.title: NVIDIA Brings Real-Time AI to Broadcast, Sports and Global Streaming at IBC
items.description: At the IBC conference, running Sept. 11-14 in Amsterdam, the creative, technology and business communities are coming together to turn ideas into action and discuss innovations across the media and entertainment industries. More than 44,000 attendees from 170+ countries are gathering to explore 1,300+ exhibitions in 14+ halls and outdoor spaces, with over 600 speakers […]
items.content: At the IBC conference, running Sept. 11-14 in Amsterdam, the creative, technology and business communities are coming together to turn ideas into action and discuss innovations across the media and entertainment industries. More than 44,000 attendees from 170+ countries are gathering to explore 1,300+ exhibitions in 14+ halls and outdoor spaces, with over 600 speakers delivering insights. Read on to learn more about what NVIDIA’s highlighting at the show. NVIDIA AI for Media Brings Real-Time Intelligence to Broadcast, Sports and Production Workflows 🔗 Media companies are increasingly integrating AI into live production, sports, news and streaming workflows to unlock richer performance insights, verify video authenticity, and enhance and localize content — all without disrupting trusted broadcast environments. At IBC 2026 in Amsterdam, NVIDIA announced a major expansion to NVIDIA AI for Media — a collection of GPU-accelerated software development kits (SDKs), NVIDIA NIM microservices, playbooks, and blueprints that enhance audio, video and augmented-reality effects for media and entertainment workflows — to unlock new ways to understand motion, verify and enhance video, localize programming and build AI-powered media applications. The NVIDIA Synthetic Video Detector (SVD) NIM microservice, announced earlier this year at SIGGRAPH, helps organizations assess the probability of whether footage is authentic or AI-generated, giving editorial, content-authentication, digital-forensics and media-integrity teams another point of analysis in their review process. Since its initial release, SVD’s accuracy has reached 99.3% for text-to-video content and 97.7% for image-to-video content, with especially large gains on difficult image-to-video cases. Dalet is integrating SVD into a secure, cloud-hosted verification workflow for news organizations. This allows editorial teams to submit footage through SVD, inspect and review the resulting scores and metadata within a Dalet interface. TwelveLabs announced the general availability of Compliance by TwelveLabs, its first application built on the company’s video intelligence platform, helping media and broadcast teams rapidly screen content against regional and custom compliance standards. The solution integrates SVD to add frame-level authenticity signals and confidence scores, enabling media teams to identify potentially synthetic media within the same compliance workflow. Wowza, whose Wowza Streaming Engine media server technology powers more than 35,000 video deployments across over 170 countries, will distribute SVD through the Wowza Video Intelligence Framework. The solution, powered by NVIDIA-accelerated infrastructure, will enable broadcasters, streaming providers and other organizations to analyze live video feeds and extract data around detected objects, scenes and signs of AI generation in real time. It can be deployed and run on premises, at the edge, in the cloud, across hybrid deployments or fully air-gapped, giving organizations greater control over critical media workflows. NVIDIA 3D Body Pose estimates 2D and 3D human joint locations and angles from video captured by a single camera, helping turn motion into structured data without marker-based capture systems. For sports organizations, that data can support player and athlete movement tracking, biomechanics and performance analysis, replay enhancement, officiating and adjudication workflows, player-safety applications, and virtual interaction and immersive experiences. The technology can also provide structured human-motion data for content-creation workflows. When mapped to a compatible character rig, joint and motion data can serve as input for animation blocking, digital doubles, character retargeting and virtual-production experiences. Vizrt is using Body Pose technology in live virtual-studio environments, with tracked body movement driving real-time 3D lighting effects such as reflections, shadows and environmental rendering. Video Frame Generation (VFG) makes video motion appear smoother by using generative AI to create new frames between the original frames of a video. It can increase frame rates by 2x or 4x while preserving visual quality and temporal consistency, enabling more fluid sports, slow-motion replays, live media and other high-motion video experiences. VFG also supports frame-rate conversion and frame boosting for generative AI video workflows. Ross Video is integrating VFG into its Rio Replay platform to create AI-assisted slow-motion video for sports production. The work supports 6x slow-motion generation for sports replay. Development is underway toward 8x interpolation, meaning generated intermediate frames can give replay teams smoother motion without requiring every frame to be captured by an ultrahigh-frame-rate source camera. NVIDIA Video Super Resolution (VSR) uses AI to upscale video while reducing noise, blur and compression artifacts. New streaming modes let developers choose between real-time performance and higher image quality, while adjustable controls help achieve the desired level of enhancement. VSR also adds 10-bit video support and improves overall performance and quality. VSR is available through the NVIDIA Video Effects SDK and a NIM microservice for use in streaming, broadcast, conferencing, video playback and content-creation applications. The technology can support video players, conferencing applications, creator tools, streaming services, transcoders and broadcast systems through a common interface. NVIDIA TrueHDR converts standard-dynamic-range video into high-dynamic-range output in real time, reaching up to approximately 2,000 nits while preserving local contrast and adapting brightness to the content. VSR, VFG and TrueHDR can be combined within a single video-effects pipeline — helping media companies enhance existing content libraries for streaming, transcoding, gaming and creator workflows. The NVIDIA LipSync and Active Speaker Detection NIM microservices help developers build localization systems for interviews, news, sports, entertainment and other programming where multiple people may appear on screen. LipSync transforms mouth movement in an input video to match a target audio track while preserving natural head pose, blinking and body movement. The new release improves facial occlusion handling and better preserves teeth, lip and facial textures. The new Active Speaker Detection NIM microservice no longer requires speaker diarization for multiple audio tracks, adds voice activity detection and expands NIM microservice deployment support through a gRPC interface and broader GPU compatibility. NDI is using NVIDIA AI for Media, including the NVIDIA LipSync NIM microservice, to enable real-time translation, lip-synced dubbing and regional language adaptation within existing broadcast workflows. By generating multiple language experiences from a common media stream, the approach can help broadcasters reach global audiences while reducing the bandwidth, infrastructure and production complexity traditionally required for multilingual distribution. Studio Voice includes new Microphone Profiles built on NVIDIA Studio Voice NIM microservices, giving users more control over the tonal character of enhanced speech. The capability is designed to suppress background noise, reduce room reverberation and improve speech clarity, then shape the enhanced output into a selected microphone profile for more polished live communications, streaming, podcasting and content creation. Try NVIDIA AI for Media NIM microservices. See the latest NVIDIA and partner workflows at IBC 2026. NVIDIA Holoscan for Media Provides Open Media Exchange Layer to Build and Connect Live Media Applications 🔗 As broadcasters, streaming services and sports organizations adopt software and AI, the infrastructure behind live content is becoming more flexible, more connected and increasingly built on shared accelerated computing. The integration of Media Exchange Layer (MXL) with NVIDIA Holoscan for Media accelerates that transition — providing the common exchange layer that helps media applications connect and operate together. Holoscan for Media is an open reference architecture and developer toolkit for building AI-powered media functions and applications for software-defined live production. MXL adds an open way for those software-based media functions to exchange live video, audio and data across a distributed environment. As production functions move into software, developers can build applications that share accelerated infrastructure, connect dynamically and evolve independently. That can help media companies use infrastructure more efficiently, introduce new capabilities faster and reduce the amount of custom integration required between applications. The integration also creates a stronger foundation for AI in live media. AI processing, video applications and traditional media functions can increasingly operate on the same accelerated infrastructure and in the same software-defined environment. For technology vendors, this expands the opportunity to build applications that can work across broader, multi-vendor ecosystems. For media companies, it creates a path toward infrastructure that can adapt as formats, applications and AI capabilities change. See the demo at IBC in EBU Stand 10.D21. ​Learn more about Holoscan for Media. NVIDIA Sports Intelligence Playbooks Chart a Path to Multimodal AI for Sports 🔗 Sports is becoming a proving ground for a broader shift in AI: from general-purpose models toward fine-tuned open models built on proprietary data. NVIDIA Sports Intelligence Playbooks are designed to accelerate that transition. They give leagues, media companies and technology providers structured frameworks to fine-tune NVIDIA open models on their own sports footage and annotations, creating multimodal AI that can understand the rules, players, scoring, strategy and context unique to a sport. Sports organizations hold large volumes of proprietary video, metadata and performance information that are difficult for competitors to replicate. The playbooks provide a practical blueprint for converting those assets into AI capabilities that can underpin new analytics products, media experiences, automation tools and revenue streams. The playbooks span the AI lifecycle, including data preparation, fine-tuning, inference, evaluation, optimization and deployment, and bring together NVIDIA technologies including Nemotron, NeMo AutoModel, Megatron Bridge, NIM microservices and NVIDIA accelerated computing. By providing an integrated path from model customization to production, Sports Intelligence Playbooks can reduce the cost and complexity of building specialized sports AI while increasing demand across its compute, software and inference stack. Early testing demonstrates the potential of domain specialization. When evaluated on previously unseen footage using question formats similar to those used in training, multiple-choice accuracy increased from approximately 53% to 94% and open-ended evaluation from approximately 5.7% to 66%. Machina Sports is integrating Sports Intelligence Playbooks with its sports-native data, evaluation and agent infrastructure, enabling rights holders to turn proprietary media and expertise into private, deployable intelligence for live production, content and fan experiences. The opportunity also expands as agentic AI becomes increasingly adopted. With the NVIDIA AI-Q Blueprint, organizations can use their domain-specific sports models as expert intelligence within agents that reason across video, enterprise data and software systems, extending the playbook from sports understanding into decision-making and automation. Wowza is integrating vision language models, including NVIDIA Cosmos 3 and Nemotron, into the Wowza Video Intelligence Framework, fine-tuned through NVIDIA Sports Intelligence Playbooks to detect sports-specific moments in live streams and reduce time to action. Explore NVIDIA Sports Intelligence Playbooks. NVIDIA Brings Multilingual Content Localization to Live Broadcast 🔗 Reaching global audiences with live programming requires more than translating words. Language nuances, voice, timing, facial movement, captions and onscreen graphics must work together in real time, while preserving the editorial intent and production quality of the original program. To help broadcasters, sports leagues, rights holders and streaming services bring these elements into a unified, software-defined, real-time localization workflow, NVIDIA is bringing its Content Localization technologies to the NVIDIA Holoscan for Media developer toolkit. Designed for broadcast and streaming developers, the reference workflow enables captions, translated audio, dubbing, synchronized video and localized graphics. Content Localization with Holoscan for Media provides a reference for how localization technologies can work together in software-defined broadcast applications. Developers can select the capabilities needed for each program, market or distribution channel rather than deploying separate infrastructure for every localized version. Content Localization with Holoscan for Media incorporates the latest advancements from NVIDIA AI for Media, including improved LipSync when faces are partially obscured and enhanced Active Speaker Detection to help applications identify who’s speaking in multi-person scenes. Expanding the Reach of Live Programming Localization can transform the reach and economics of live programming. A shared, composable workflow can help media companies introduce regional coverage faster, serve more audiences and tailor experiences for individual markets — while preserving the timing, visual context and editorial control required for live production. Technologies from AI-Media, CAMB.AI, Chyron and Panjaya each address a specific part of content localization with Holoscan for Media, from adapting voice and onscreen delivery to creating multilingual captions and translated audio, localizing graphics, and preserving expression and identity across live and on-demand content. The Content Localization technologies also support file-based, streaming and post-production applications. Developers can use application programming interfaces for on-demand workflows and the Holoscan for Media reference workflow when localization must run as part of a live media environment. Together, they provide a consistent foundation for building multilingual media services across production and distribution. Learn more about NVIDIA Holoscan for Media and AI for Media.

items.titleZh: NVIDIA Brings Real-Time AI to Broadcast, Sports and Global Streaming at IBC
items.descriptionZh:
在9月11日至14日于阿姆斯特丹举行的IBC大会上，创意、技术和商业领域人士齐聚一堂，探讨媒体与娱乐行业的创新。超过44,000名来自170多个国家的参会者，在14个以上展厅及户外空间参观了1,300多个展位，聆听了600多位演讲者的分享。本届IBC上，NVIDIA重点展示了一系列将实时AI能力引入广播、体育和制作流程的技术方案，核心是“NVIDIA AI for Media”产品组合的显著扩展。

**NVIDIA AI for Media：为媒体工作流注入实时智能**

媒体公司正越来越普遍地将AI集成到直播、体育、新闻和流媒体工作流中，以挖掘更深度的表现洞察、验证视频真实性、增强及本地化内容，且不破坏既有可信广播环境的稳定性。NVIDIA AI for Media是一套GPU加速的软件开发套件（SDK）、NIM微服务、playbooks和blueprints集合，旨在增强音视频及增强现实效果。此次发布带来了多项关键技术进展，包括合成视频检测、人体姿态估计、视频帧生成、超分辨率、HDR转换、唇形同步和说话人识别等。

针对AI生成内容识别，NVIDIA在SIGGRAPH上发布的NVIDIA合成视频探测器（SVD）NIM微服务现已取得显著精度提升。SVD能评估一段视频是真迹还是AI生成，供编辑、内容验证、数字取证和媒体完整性团队作为审查依据。自首次发布以来，SVD对文本生成视频内容识别准确率达到99.3%，对图像生成视频内容准确率达97.7%，在困难的图像转视频案例上提升尤为明显。多家合作伙伴正在集成SVD：Dalet将其整合到云托管的安全验证工作流中，使新闻编辑团队可在Dalet界面中提交视频、检查评分和元数据；TwelveLabs发布首个基于其视频智能平台的应用“Compliance by TwelveLabs”，帮助媒体和广播团队按区域及定制合规标准快速筛查内容，该方案集成SVD以提供逐帧真实性信号和置信度评分；Wowza则将SVD整合到其视频智能框架中，该框架已为超过170个国家的35,000多个视频部署提供核心服务，新方案由NVIDIA加速基础设施驱动，可实时分析直播视频流，提取检测到的对象、场景和AI生成迹象数据，部署方式灵活，支持本地、边缘、云端、混合乃至完全隔离的离网环境。

NVIDIA 3D Body Pose技术可从单摄像头视频中估计人体二维和三维关节位置与角度，无需标记点动作捕捉系统即可将动作转化为结构化数据。体育组织可利用该数据进行球员运动追踪、生物力学与表现分析、回放增强、裁判判罚辅助、球员安全应用以及虚拟互动和沉浸体验。同时，该技术还能为内容创作提供结构化人体运动数据，映射到兼容的角色骨骼上后，可作为动画预演、数字替身、角色重定向和虚拟制片的输入。Vizrt已在虚拟演播室环境中应用该技术，用身体运动驱动实时3D照明效果，如反射、阴影和环境渲染。

视频帧生成技术（VFG）利用生成式AI在原始帧之间创建新的中间帧，将帧率提升2倍或4倍，同时保持视觉质量和时间一致性，从而使体育比赛、慢动作回放、直播及其他高动态视频播放更流畅。VFG还支持帧率转换和帧增强，适用于生成式AI视频工作流。Ross Video将VFG集成进其Rio Replay平台，用于体育制作的AI辅助慢动作回放，目前已支持6倍慢动作生成，并正在开发8倍插值能力——这意味着回放团队无需依赖超高帧率源摄像机捕捉每一帧，也能获得更流畅的运动画面。

NVIDIA视频超分辨率（VSR）利用AI提升视频分辨率，同时降低噪点、模糊和压缩伪影。新版增加了多种流媒体模式，可在实时性能与更高画质之间灵活选择，并提供可调控制参数；还新增10位视频支持，整体性能和画质进一步改善。VSR通过NVIDIA Video Effects SDK及NIM微服务提供，可用于流媒体、广播、会议、视频播放和内容创作。

NVIDIA TrueHDR能将标准动态范围（SDR）视频实时转换为高动态范围（HDR）输出，峰值亮度最高约2,000尼特，同时保留局部对比度并根据内容自适应调节亮度。VSR、VFG和TrueHDR可组合在单一视频效果链路中，帮助媒体公司对现有内容库进行增强，适用于流媒体、转码、游戏和创作者工作流。

针对多语言节目本地化，NVIDIA LipSync与Active Speaker Detection（说话人检测）NIM微服务帮助开发者构建访谈、新闻、体育和娱乐等多人出境场景的本地化系统。LipSync能使输入视频中的嘴部动作与目标音频轨道匹配，同时保持自然的头部姿态、眨眼和身体动作；新版本改进了面部遮挡处理，更好地保留牙齿、嘴唇和面部纹理细节。新的Active Speaker Detection NIM微服务不再需要对多音频轨进行说话人分离，增加了语音活动检测，并通过gRPC接口和更广泛的GPU兼容性扩展了部署支持。NDI已采用包括LipSync在内的NVIDIA AI for Media技术，在现有广播工作流中实现实时翻译、唇形同步配音和区域语言适配——通过从单一媒体流生成多语言版本，帮助广播商以更低的带宽、基础设施和生产复杂度触达全球观众。Studio Voice则新增了基于NVIDIA Studio Voice NIM微服务构建的麦克风配置文件，用户可在抑制背景噪声、减少室内混响、提高语音清晰度的基础上，将增强后的语音塑造成所选麦克风的音色特征，适用于实时通信、直播、播客和内容创作。

**Holoscan for Media：开放媒体交换层**

随着广播商、流媒体服务和体育组织逐步采用软件和AI，直播内容背后的基础设施正变得更灵活、更互联且越来越依赖共享加速计算。Media Exchange Layer（MXL）与NVIDIA Holoscan for Media的集成正是这一转变的关键——MXL提供的媒体交换层能让不同媒体应用互相连接并协同运行。Holoscan for Media是一个开放参考架构和开发者工具包，用于构建面向软件定义直播的AI媒体功能和应用。MXL为这些基于软件的媒体功能提供了在分布式环境中交换实时视频、音频和数据的开放方式。生产功能进入软件层后，开发者可以构建共享加速基础设施、动态连接且独立演进的应用，帮助媒体公司更高效地利用基础设施、更快推出新功能，并减少应用间的大量定制集成需求。对于AI与直播的融合而言，该集成为AI处理、视频应用和传统媒体功能在同一套加速基础设施和软件定义环境中运行奠定了更强基础，使技术厂商能够构建跨越更广泛多供应商生态的应用，也让媒体公司的基础设施能随格式、应用和AI能力的变化而演进。

**Sports Intelligence Playbooks：体育多模态AI的实践蓝图**

体育正在成为AI从通用模型转向基于专有数据的微调开放模型的试验场。NVIDIA Sports Intelligence Playbooks提供结构化框架，帮助联盟、媒体公司和技术提供商在自有体育视频和标注数据上微调NVIDIA开放模型，构建能理解特定运动项目的规则、球员、得分、战术和语境的多模态AI。体育机构拥有大量难以复制的专有视频、元数据和表现数据，playbooks提供了将这些资产转化为AI能力的实用路径，支撑分析产品、媒体体验、自动化工具和新收入流。Playbooks覆盖数据准备、微调、推理、评估、优化和部署全生命周期，整合了Nemotron、NeMo AutoModel、Megatron Bridge、NIM微服务及加速计算。NVIDIA指出，早期测试显示出领域定制的巨大潜力：当用与训练相似的提问格式评估从未见过的视频时，选择题准确率从约53%提升至94%，开放式问答评估从约5.7%提升至66%。Machina Sports正在将其体育原生数据、评估和智能体基础设施与Playbooks集成，使版权方可将专有媒体和专业知识转化为可部署的私有人工智能，用于直播制作、内容和粉丝体验。此外，随着智能体AI（agentic AI）普及，借助NVIDIA AI-Q Blueprint，各组织可将领域专属体育模型作为智能体中的专家推理引擎，使其在视频、企业数据和软件系统中进行推理，将应用范围从理解扩展到决策与自动化。Wowza也将Cosmos 3和Nemotron等视觉语言模型集成到Wowza视频智能框架，并通过Playbooks微调以检测直播流中的体育特定时刻、缩短反应时间。

**面向直播的多语种内容本地化方案**

为全球观众提供直播节目不仅是翻译文字，还需在实时中协调语言细微差别、声音、时机、面部活动、字幕和屏幕图形，同时保持原节目的编辑意图和制作质量。NVIDIA将内容本地化技术整合到Holoscan for Media开发者工具包中，提供一套统一的软件定义实时本地化参考工作流，支持字幕、音频翻译、配音、同步视频和本地化图形。广播和流媒体开发者可为每个节目、市场或发行渠道选择所需功能，而无需为每个版部署独立基础设施。该方案集成了NVIDIA AI for Media的最新成果，包括部分面部被遮挡时的LipSync改进和多人场景下更准确的Active Speaker Detection。AI-Media、CAMB.AI、Chyron和Panjaya分别在不同的本地化环节与之协作，覆盖声音与屏幕表现调整、多语言字幕与音频翻译、图形本地化，以及直播和点播内容的表达与身份保留。除直播外，这些技术还支持文件型、流式及后期制作应用，开发者可通过API用于按需工作流，也可在直播环境中使用Holoscan for Media参考工作流，从而在制作与分发环节构建一致的多语言媒体服务基础。

总体而言，NVIDIA在IBC 2026上呈现的AI技术覆盖了内容真实性验证、体育战术分析、慢动作与画质增强、多语言实时本地化以及开放媒体基础设施等多个层面，并与Dalet、TwelveLabs、Wowza、Vizrt、Ross Video、NDI、Machina Sports、AI-Media等众多伙伴深度合作，展示出AI正从单点工具走向可组合、可编排的媒体生产全流程。

items.title: OpenAI says its next-generation processors could be made at Samsung — double-sourcing with TSMC hints at massive volume requirements
items.description: OpenAI deepens chip cooperation with Samsung, possibly prepares to Double source AI ASICs from two foundries in a bid to get more in-house silicon to its data centers.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter OpenAI is expanding its relationship with Samsung beyond memory supply and enterprise software as the AI giant plans to outsource production of at least some of its processors to Samsung Foundry, Harrison Kim, General Manager of OpenAI Korea, revealed this week. If the information is accurate, then OpenAI will source its AI accelerators from both TSMC and Samsung Foundry, which suggests massive volume requirements.Go deeper with TH Premium: CPU (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Intel VP Robert Hallock sets Nova Lake expectations, teases return to Raptor Lake for DDR4 platformsCPU scaling with DLSSIntel's one-two punch plan in desktop CPUs is taking shapeBenchmarking AMD's BC-250, offering Steam Machine-like performance at half the priceAMD splits Zen 7 into three EPYC families for 2028 and starts selling server CPUs by the agent "One of the areas where we have made the most progress and gained the most recognition with Samsung Electronics is our joint production and ​research on the next-generation chips we are developing," said Harrison Kim, General Manager of OpenAI Korea, at ​a press conference in Seoul, Reuters reports.OpenAI already has its own AI ASIC program that relies on Broadcom's design services as well as TSMC's wafer processing and advanced packaging services. So far, the company has introduced its first inference AI accelerator called Jalapeño that was defined by the company's engineers, then co-designed with Broadcom, then made by TSMC, all in less than 18 months.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: OpenAI did not explain whether Samsung's participation concerns a second production source for Jalapeño, another processor under development by OpenAI, a chip jointly developed by Samsung and OpenAI, or some other aspect of chip production and development. Samsung and SK hynix already supply memory for OpenAI's Stargate data center initiative, though joint chip development and production barely have a relation to DRAM supply.OpenAI's 1st Generation Jalapeño will unlikely be double-sourced from TSMC and Samsung because the chip is already in mass production at TSMC and OpenAI is talking about 'next-generation chips,' not the ones that are in mass production at the moment. Furthermore, development of Jalapeño's successor is well underway and is approaching tapeout, which means that its mass production is not far away either. Since OpenAI's claim clearly involves 'next-generation chips,' it is entirely possible that OpenAI will indeed produce its 2nd Generation inference ASIC at Samsung Foundry. You may like Tesla's AI5 with 2nm-class node tapes out at Samsung Foundry — production starts soon, months after TSMC tape out OpenAI’s 700W Jalapeño ASIC outpaces 1,400W Nvidia flagship GPU Hot Chips 2026: OpenAI's Jalapeño AI ASIC unpacked Back in late July, Samsung Electronics and Broadcom announced a strategic partnership valued at over $200 billion through 2030 to collaborate on advanced foundry, memory, and packaging technologies for AI infrastructure. Hence, as OpenAI has an agreement with Broadcom to procure 10GW of custom AI accelerators, it will be able to produce these accelerators at both Samsung and TSMC. Of course, if it needs silicon produced at Samsung, and pays Broadcom for appropriate design porting.Perhaps, OpenAI will take a page from Tesla's book and will double-source Jalapeño's successor from TSMC and Samsung to get higher volumes. However, Tesla's volume requirements may be different from those of OpenAI.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsTesla needs extraordinary AI5 volumes because it intends to use the processor across three very different high-volume applications: AI data centers, vehicles, and Optimus robots. Therefore, Tesla could potentially need millions of AI5 chips for cars alone, on top of robots and data-center deployments. Therefore, paying for separate TSMC and Samsung physical implementations gives Tesla not only supply-chain resilience but also aggregate capacity necessary to supply several product categories.Yet, data center accelerators tend to be vastly more silicon-intensive per unit compared to ASICs for vehicles or robots. If OpenAI/Broadcom's next ASIC is a large leading-edge processor with multiple dies and OpenAI wants gigawatts of these processors, wafer requirements could still become too high for TSMC alone (which is fully booked by the likes of AMD and Nvidia). In that situation, OpenAI may need another foundry to get enough ASICs. Still, we are speculating. items.titleZh: OpenAI says its next-generation processors could be made at Samsung — double-sourcing with TSMC hints at massive volume requirements
items.descriptionZh:
OpenAI正在进一步深化与三星电子的合作，其韩国分公司总经理Harrison Kim在首尔的一场新闻发布会上透露，OpenAI计划将至少部分处理器的生产外包给三星代工部门。这一消息意味着，OpenAI的AI加速器未来将同时由台积电和三星代工生产，从而反映其巨大的芯片需求量。

值得注意的是，三星和SK海力士此前已为OpenAI的Stargate数据中心计划供应存储芯片，但此次合作涉及的是下一代芯片的联合研发与生产，与DRAM供应关系不大。Harrison Kim表示，与三星电子取得最大进展和认可的领域，正是他们在共同研发的下一代芯片上的联合生产与研究。

背景上，OpenAI已经拥有自主AI ASIC项目，该项目依托博通的设计服务以及台积电的晶圆制造和先进封装服务。此前，OpenAI已推出首款自研推理AI加速器，代号Jalapeño。这款芯片由OpenAI工程师定义，博通协助设计，台积电负责制造，整个流程从定义到量产耗时不到18个月，展示了极强的研发效率。

不过，OpenAI并未详细说明三星参与的具体角色——究竟是作为Jalapeño的第二生产来源、OpenAI正在开发的其他处理器、由三星与OpenAI联合开发的新芯片，还是涉及其它制造环节。业界分析认为，第一代Jalapeño不太可能同时由台积电和三星双源供货，因为它已在台积电量产，而OpenAI高层谈及的是“下一代芯片”。当前Jalapeño的继任者研发已接近流片阶段，距离量产不远。因此，完全可能将第二代推理ASIC交由三星代工生产。

从产业链动态看，三星电子与博通早在2025年7月底就宣布了一项到2030年总价值超过200亿美元的战略合作，聚焦AI基础设施所需的先进代工、存储和封装技术。而OpenAI本身与博通签有采购10GW定制AI加速器的协议，因此通过博通，OpenAI所设计的芯片既可以交由台积电，也可以交由三星制造——前提是支付相应的设计移植费用。

类似的“双源”策略在特斯拉身上已有先例。特斯拉的AI5芯片刚刚在三星代工完成2nm级工艺节点的流片，并在台积电流片数月之后启动生产。特斯拉之所以愿意承担两套物理实现的费用，是因为AI5将部署在三个需求极大的领域：AI数据中心、汽车以及Optimus机器人。仅汽车一项就可能需要数百万颗芯片，加上机器人和数据中心部署，总量需求庞大，单一晶圆厂难以满足。因此，双源供货不仅提供了供应链韧性，还能扩展总体产能。

相比之下，数据中心AI加速器单片对硅资源的需求远高于汽车或机器人用的ASIC。如果OpenAI与博通的下一代ASIC是包含多芯片的大尺寸先进处理器，并且需要千兆瓦级规模的部署，那么即使台积电也难以独立满足如此惊人的晶圆需求，尤其是台积电还被AMD、英伟达等客户大量预订。在这种情况下，OpenAI很可能需要引入第二家晶圆厂来获得足够的芯片供应。当然，媒体也指出，这些仍是基于现有信息的合理推测，最终能否以及如何落地，还需等待官方进一步确认。

综合来看，OpenAI与三星代工的合作若成真，将打破AI加速器制造基本由台积电垄断的局面，为大规模AI算力基础设施构建更稳固、更多元的供应链。同时，这也可能推动博通主导的定制ASIC生态进一步向三星开放的先进工艺产能拓展，塑造未来AI芯片生产的新格局。

items.title: Goodram PX700 2TB SSD Review: High-end punch on a budget core
items.description: The Goodram PX700 matches good all-around performance with high power-efficiency in a cool-running package. It performs mostly like a premium drive, although pricing remains a concern.
items.content: The Goodram PX700 is a budget PCIe 4.0 drive that delivers everything you need: good performance, great power efficiency, and all in a single-sided package that runs cool. Sometimes it really is as simple as picking one drive to meet whatever your storage needs are at the moment. It’s not the first model that comes to mind for this segment, but in our testing it performed better than expected as a good drive that may otherwise run under the radar.Goodram is not a new or no-name company, even if the “good RAM” moniker seems a little too on the nose. Instead, it’s a memory assembler in the EU with quite some history. This, in fact, makes it more approachable in comparison to a lot of the new names we have seen on AliExpress and increasingly on Amazon. We expect reliability or at least good support from the company, and the TBW on this one seems to reflect that this isn’t an ultra-budget drive.On the contrary, performance was not just what we expected – considering we’ve reviewed many drives in this segment, many with the same or comparable hardware – but above. Sometimes only by a small amount, but the gaps are real. Anywhere performance mattered, it delivered. One expects trade-offs for that, but in fact the PX700 is very power-efficient, and the drive provides an excellent storage experience. The only downsides are sustained write performance – which is of little importance in most cases – and, unfortunately, the price. At the right price point, this would be a great pick for any device.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Goodram PX700 2TB SSD (2TB Black) at Amazon for $613Goodram PX700 Specifications Swipe to scroll horizontally Product 1TB 2TB 4TB Header Cell - Column 4 Header Cell - Column 5 Header Cell - Column 6 Header Cell - Column 7 Pricing $348.00 $613.00 N/A Form Factor M.2 2280 (Single-sided) M.2 2280 (Single-sided) M.2 2280 (Single-sided) Interface / Protocol PCIe 4.0 x4 / NVMe 2.0 PCIe 4.0 x4 / NVMe 2.0 PCIe 4.0 x4 / NVMe 2.0 Controller Maxio MAP1602 Maxio MAP1602 Maxio MAP1602 DRAM N/A (HMB) N/A (HMB) N/A (HMB) Memory 232-Layer NAND Flash 232-Layer NAND Flash 232-Layer NAND Flash Sequential Read 7,400 MB/s 7,400 MB/s 7,400 MB/s Sequential Write 6,500 MB/s 6,500 MB/s 6,500 MB/s Random Read 1,000K IOPS 1,000K IOPS 1,000K IOPS Random Write 820K IOPS 820K IOPS 1,000K IOPS Endurance 600TBW 1,200TBW 2,400TBW Part Number SSDPR-PX700-01T-80 SSDPR-PX700-02T-80 SSDPR-PX700-04T-80 Warranty 5-year 5-year 5-year Today's best Goodram PX700 2TB SSD deals $613View No price informationCheck Best BuyWe check over 250 million products every day for the best pricesThe Goodram PX700 covers the most popular capacities of 1TB, 2TB, and 4TB. Smaller drives can be popular for upgrades and basic boot usage, especially with how prices are now, but modern flash scales best at 1TB and up. 8TB drives are great as a larger storage solution but require a significant investment. The PX700 sticks to what will sell, predominantly 1TB and 2TB. At the time of review, these are priced at $346 and $418, respectively. These prices are high and probably point to a lack of stock more than anything else. While the 1TB price is double what it should be, at 2TB a drive of this type should be closer to $300. Naturally, one has to take into account the pricing volatility in an SSD market besieged by a NAND shortage, but we recommend looking in that range for this drive or one comparable to it with similar or the same hardware.The drive is full-fledged Gen 4 with performance up to 7,400 / 6,500 MB/s for sequential reads and writes and up to 1 million random read and write IOPS at 4TB with only 820K write at 1TB/2TB. This is standard for the class and is more than enough performance for everyday tasks, gaming, productivity workflows, and more. The drive has the standard five-year warranty with up to 600TB of writes for every TB. The last part of that is worth a second glance because it indicates this drive can come with TLC rather than QLC flash, since TLC, aside from being faster, has better endurance than QLC. However, we have reasons to believe our sample has QLC, which we will point out where the evidence supports that reasoning. We want to emphasize that you should not assume what flash a drive uses based on TBW alone.Goodram PX700 Software and AccessoriesGoodram does not offer any specialized or custom software for its SSDs. You will have to rely on third-party solutions. Software for SSDs essentially falls into three categories: health management, performance, and data backup. SSD toolbox applications from manufacturers will usually cover the first two, with, typically, an OEM version of Acronis True Image for the last. For free alternatives, we recommend CrystalDiskInfo for health information, CrystalDiskMark for basic benchmarking, and MultiDrive for data backup and imaging. MultiDrive is made for Windows and has a bootable WinPE image, so for other operating systems you can opt to use Clonezilla instead.Goodram PX700: A Closer Look Image 1 of 2 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 2 View Original Image 2 of 2 View Original The PX700 is a single-sided drive at all capacity points. This makes it compatible with a wider range of systems and, if you need to cool the drive, it’s easier to tackle just one side of components. As it turns out, the drive runs cool enough that you probably don’t have to worry about this – check the Power Consumption and Temperature section below – but it’s still worth pointing out. The data on the rear label is standard, but we do want to say a little bit more about the listed manufacturer.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsWilk Elektronik is a Poland-based memory company, which makes this interesting, as that means the PX700 is a European-assembled SSD. Goodram covers the mainstream parts and IRDM enthusiast, although this is the first SSD from them that we’ve reviewed. As we are going to dig into the hardware in this section, we will say that the drive's silicon is sourced from Asia, as with virtually every SSD. If we say a drive is made in Poland, this means the drive is assembled, tested, and covered by warranty in Poland with an EU anchor. For some, that might be a positive factor in any purchasing decision. Image 1 of 3 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 3 View Original Image 2 of 3 View Original Image 3 of 3 View Original Identifying the hardware here is half simple and half challenging. The controller is clearly the Maxio MAP1602, a four-channel, DRAM-less part that’s been a budget champion for quite some time. There is not much mystery there aside from maybe this being a later revision, typically used for higher capacities.The flash is more difficult. We can ascertain that these are 512GB NAND flash packages from the “512G” – given modern flash is 1Tb or 128GB, four dies per package for a total of sixteen dies. That’s perfect for maximizing performance out of this controller. The “W2533” is likely the manufacture date of week 33, year 2025. All this indicates is that this is, at least, not older flash, although we already know it has to be 2,400 MT/s at a minimum to hit the specified performance.It makes a lot of sense for the PX700 to use TLC flash, though, given the TBW and the fact that we’ve been seeing this controller with 232-Layer Micron TLC more frequently lately. The Biwin Black Opal NV7400 comes to mind. However, Goodram has access to YMTC flash, and that includes QLC. YMTC rather than Micron QLC is more likely, given the latter is in high demand in enterprise. Normally, you could use certain utilities to identify the flash, but firmware for this controller is often encrypted to avoid revealing the flash ID. It’s still possible to get around this with leaked MP tools, but otherwise the best way to identify it is simply to look at the performance. items.titleZh: Goodram PX700 2TB SSD Review: High-end punch on a budget core
items.descriptionZh:
Goodram PX700是一款定位主流/入门级的PCIe 4.0 NVMe固态硬盘。尽管这个波兰品牌并不像三星、西数那样常被提及，但Goodram隶属的Wilk Elektronik是一家在欧洲颇具历史的存储模组厂，而非新兴的无名品牌。此次评测的PX700系列提供1TB、2TB和4TB三种容量，均为M.2 2280规格、单面PCB设计，这种设计不仅兼容性更好，也更利于散热。该盘搭载Maxio MAP1602主控——这是一颗无DRAM缓存、采用HMB（主机内存缓冲）技术的四通道控制器，在入门级市场已是久经考验的成熟方案。搭配232层NAND闪存，官方标称顺序读取7400 MB/s、顺序写入6500 MB/s，随机读取1000K IOPS、随机写入820K IOPS（4TB版本为1000K）。值得注意的是，其耐用性标称达到每TB容量600TBW（即1TB版600TBW、2TB版1200TBW、4TB版2400TBW），并提供5年质保。仅从TBW来看，这通常意味着TLC闪存，但评测者指出，不能仅凭TBW断定闪存类型——通过初步拆解和硬件观察，该盘可能使用了YMTC（长江存储）的QLC闪存，因为Goodram有渠道获取YMTC颗粒，且Micron的QLC多被企业级市场包走；不过此类主控固件常加密防止读取Flash ID，最终结论需结合性能测试判断。

在性能实测中，PX700的表现超出了评测者的预期。考虑到类似硬件在市场上已有众多产品，多数产品表现平庸，但PX700在各项性能指标上不仅达标，部分项目还有小幅领先。尤其是在能效方面表现出色，运行温度也足够低，单面设计让散热处理更加容易。评测者认为，除了持续写入性能偏弱（这在实际使用中影响不大）以及当前过高的定价外，PX700整体提供了出色的存储体验。原文特别指出，评测时2TB版价格高达613美元，1TB也要348美元，这显然远高于合理价位——2TB级别同规格产品的合理价格应在300美元左右；虽然NAND缺货导致SSD市场价格波动剧烈是部分原因，但该盘目前显然缺乏竞争力。如果价格回落到合适区间，它将在该价位段成为一个优秀的选项。

软件方面，Goodram不提供专属SSD管理工具，用户需借助第三方软件完成健康监测（如CrystalDiskInfo）、性能测试（如CrystalDiskMark）和数据备份（如Acronis True Image或免费的MultiDrive）。此外，该盘所有容量点均为单面设计，背面标签信息普通，但值得强调其“欧洲组装”背景：虽然主控和闪存颗粒来自亚洲（几乎全行业如此），但PX700在波兰完成组装、测试与质保，对于看重欧洲供应链的消费者来说可能是个加分项。总体而言，这是一款在性能和能效上“超预期”但“价格错位”的入门级PCIe 4.0 SSD——它具备成为中端市场黑马的潜力，前提是定价回归理性。

items.title: OpenAI claims GPT-6 Astra is an ethereal 'Alien Mind' with AGI-like qualities — company warns of alignment challenges as new frontier leader emerges
items.description: OpenAI has made bold claims with its new GPT-6 Astra AI model, and it's certainly capable, but benchmarks suggest it has many of the usual weaknesses alongside the strengths, while cost and accessibility are still the biggest factors in widespread usage.
items.content: Share Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter "AI is grown, more than designed," OpenAI's chief scientist, Jakub Pachocki, said in a new blog post on the company's latest GPT-6 Astra release. Titling the piece "An Alien Mind," Pachocki portrays the latest large language model as something more ethereal and harder to quantify. Jensen Huang calls it AGI, and OpenAI claims it's the best, most aligned model the company has ever released. It's safer to delegate, better at complex work tasks, and it can even beat Portal in just a few hours.Huang also said that AGI had previously been achieved back in March earlier this year. Artificial Analysis benchmarks suggest Astra is about as smart as Fable 5.1 - though crucially, cheaper on a per-task basis. Astra may well be better aligned than models in the past, and it may well be more capable in specific tasks and specific benchmarks. However, the claims that the model has achieved AGI, or Artificial General Intelligence, suggest an inflection point for the AI industry.Astra's release comes alongside calls for an industry slowdown, greater government oversight, and controls on the AI industry. Now, OpenAI's Astra raises more eyebrows about frontier-level intelligence.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Trust us, we don't know what we're doingThe tone around OpenAI's Astra release is intriguing. OpenAI's produced a new set of benchmarks, touting bold claims about the model's reasoning capabilities, with the model trained on 100,000 Blackwell GPUs, with more coming soon.GPT-6 Astra, trained on ~100K+ NVIDIA Grace Blackwell NVLink72. From ChatGPT to o1 to Astra in 4 years.AGI has arrived. Congratulations @OpenAI team.400K GPUs coming online next.September 6, 2026But Pachocki's blog post is much more nebulous. While Huang touts that AGI has arrived publicly, Pachocki says AI can only ever "simulate facets of human behaviour," not recreate it. He describes AI development as an experimental process that often "surprises" developers, with results that are "harder to interpret." You may like OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra model autonomously completes Portal in 24 hours AI companies are now racing to the bottom — crashing token prices and competitive models push companies to cut costs Frontier AI faces pricing reckoning as token volume explodes 25-fold "An aligned AI should act with honesty and integrity, with love for humanity," Pachocki said. He speaks a lot on alignment, and it's encouraging that OpenAI is so keen to embed human moral understanding into its developments. Although OpenAI appears to be doing this more by orienting the model's goals towards a moralistic outcome, rather than helping to intrinsically understand human morality.It's certainly different to the tack taken by other AI developers, where the likes of xAI's Grok was released with the ability to generate harmful content.But the timing of Pachocki's warning is a little suspect. OpenAI has faced increasing pressure of late for its models to be more affordable, with Chinese alternatives like Deepseek V4, Kimi K3, as well as Western models like Google's Gemini Flash 3.8 and Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 offering compelling levels of intelligence at a much more affordable price than the frontier models.It's perhaps telling that even for all its intelligence and alignment pre-training, GPT 6 Astra is notably cheaper to run on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index than its chief rival, Anthropic's Fable 5.1 — which still retains the top spot on that Intelligence Index at the time of writing. Though it's 50% more expensive than GPT 5.6 Sol on the same tasks.It's a researcher, but imagine what it could beA huge component of marketing from the major AI developers has consistently been grounded in the idea that, as good as the models are now, just imagine how capable they're going to be in the future. What to read next Chinese Z.ai's latest model tops AI ranking charts amid Anthropic Fable 5 ban Kimi K3 rocks the AI industry as Moonshot AI undercuts closed-source American competitors on price OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and unreleased AI models break out of testing environment in 'unprecedented cybersecurity incident' This was very much the underlying tone in Pachocki's breakdown of Astra's design and functions. Although he and OpenAI make broad suggestions about intelligence, and that the likes of Astra could be this new kind of intelligence which we don't really understand but can definitely control and corral, Pachocki ends his post by making it very clear that we aren't there yet.OpenAI is prioritizing three areas of work with AI, and of late it's really just been trying to make a really good researcher. That's where we're at right now, with Astra representing the latest and best effort to develop that. Then comes the scientific progress, he said, and then everyone gets their own individual, personalized AGI helper.Intriguingly, though, that seems to suggest that's something that everyone is clamoring for. Outside of the AI-boosting programmers who jump on each new hot model, the larger work comes in helping non-technical users understand the capabilities of these new, powerful AI models.Tools, research capabilities, drug discovery, and pattern recognition on big datasets that find new insights and improve analytics are all legitimate and useful ways in which an AI researcher can be deployed, but in the near term, most of the general populace just don't want AI to take their jobs, and for it to be less scary.It's encouraging that Pachocki's blog ends on a similar note of caution."We need to find ways to preserve human agency and enshrine an intrinsic value to being human, in a world where most tasks could be performed by AI."That's key, but intriguingly, he also calls on others to take charge of that effort.We didn't start the fireIn the aftermath of cost concerns and token usage exploding among more affordable alternatives, Pachocki wants everyone to slow down, and OpenAI wants world governments to be in charge of it."I believe that international coordination on future AI development needs to become a top priority for governments around the world," Pachocki said, calling for voluntary slowdowns and hinting that if that doesn't happen, enforcing it may need to come via legislation instead."... to ensure that humans remain in control of the future and are not left behind by unchecked progress, brought about by an alien intellect exceeding our own."The threat of runaway is valid, and the "singularity" moment is a common trope in sci-fi that AI evangelists have been warning about for years. But Astra isn't AGI. Even getting anyone to agree on what AGI even means is hard enough.Astra is more aligned and wins some new benchmarks, loses some others. It's another improved coding model with some impressive chops.Astra is not an alien mind. Framing it as an unknowable entity, by the very people who made it, can read as inflammatory, especially in the context of calls for AI legislation from governments around the globe.OpenAI's post might read like a post from a non-profit, but it very specifically became for-profit last year. With a future IPO looming, slowing down the competition by calling for legislation may be just as effective a strategy as rolling out a new model.
items.author: Jon Martindale
items.titleZh: OpenAI claims GPT-6 Astra is an ethereal 'Alien Mind' with AGI-like qualities — company warns of alignment challenges as new frontier leader emerges
items.descriptionZh:
OpenAI最新旗舰模型GPT-6 Astra的发布引发了行业内外极为分裂的解读。OpenAI首席科学家Jakub Pachocki在名为《外星思维》（An Alien Mind）的博客文章中，将这款大型语言模型描述为一种“被生长出来而非设计出来”的存在，更像某种难以量化、难以解释的“外星智能”；而NVIDIA CEO黄仁勋则在社交媒体上高调宣称“AGI已经到来”，并祝贺OpenAI团队。OpenAI官方声称Astra是公司有史以来发布的最强大、对齐程度最高的模型，在复杂工作任务中更安全、更可靠，甚至能自主在数小时内通关经典游戏《传送门》。黄仁勋还补充说，早在今年3月，AGI就已实现。

不过，独立评测机构Artificial Analysis的基准测试显示，Astra的智能水平与Anthropic的旗舰模型Fable 5.1大致相当，但每次任务的推理成本更低。尽管Astra可能在特定任务和对齐指标上优于以往模型，但将其冠以“通用人工智能”（AGI）之名，仍令许多人感到质疑和不安，尤其是在行业内部正出现要求放缓研发、加强政府监管的呼声之际。

技术层面，据推文透露，GPT-6 Astra使用了超过10万块NVIDIA Grace Blackwell NVLink72 GPU进行训练，且未来还有40万块GPU即将上线。从ChatGPT到o1再到Astra，时间跨度仅为四年。但Pachocki的博客写得极为模糊悬疑。他一方面承认黄仁勋所宣扬的AGI叙事，另一方面又强调AI只能“模拟人类行为的某些侧面”，而非真正“重现”人类智能。他将AI开发过程描述为一种实验性过程，结果常令开发者感到“惊讶”，且“难以解读”。关于对齐问题，他表示“一个对齐的AI应当以诚实和正直行事，并对人类怀有爱”。OpenAI显然是试图将模型的优化目标导向具有道德意义的结果，而不是让模型真正内化人类道德。这种取向与xAI的Grok等允许生成有害内容的做法截然不同。

但Pachocki发出这一谨慎信号的时机耐人寻味。OpenAI近期正面临巨大的价格压力：来自中国的DeepSeek V4、Kimi K3，以及西方的Google Gemini Flash 3.8、Meta Muse Spark 1.3等模型，都以远低于前沿模型的价格提供可观性能。即便GPT-6 Astra在Artificial Analysis的智能指数上比其主要对手Anthropic Fable 5.1明显更便宜（后者目前仍居该指数首位），但相比OpenAI自家的GPT-5.6 Sol，Astra在执行相同任务时成本仍高出50%。换言之，Astra在价格上只是“更便宜的前沿模型”，并未彻底打破成本困局。

在阐述未来方向时，Pachocki延续了AI行业一贯的叙事逻辑——现在的模型已经足够好，但真正颠覆性的能力仍在未来。他明确表示目前OpenAI主要聚焦于三个领域：首先是打造真正优秀的“AI研究员”，Astra正是这一方向的最新努力；其次是推动科学进步；最后是让每个人拥有自己的个性化AGI助手。然而，作者指出，这种愿景主要迎合了追逐新模型的开发者群体；对于更广泛的非技术用户而言，当务之急是帮助他们理解这些强大模型的实际能力与风险。AI研究员确实可被用于工具调用、科研辅助、药物发现、海量数据模式识别与分析等正经用途，但短期内普通大众的诉求仍然是：不要抢走我的工作、不要那么吓人。Pachocki的博客结尾以一段同样审慎的话收束：“我们需要找到方法，保留人类的主导地位，在一个大多数任务都可由AI完成的世界里，确立作为人的内在价值。”

更值得注意的是，Pachocki在文中呼吁全球各国政府将“未来AI发展的国际协调”列为最高优先级，建议行业自愿减速；若做不到，则可能需通过立法强制执行。他警告说：“要确保人类始终掌控未来，不被一种超越我们的外来智力因不受约束的进步而抛在后面。”这类对“失控智能”和“奇点”的担忧在科幻与AI福音派中早已是老生常谈，但作者尖锐地指出：Astra并不是AGI，而且业内连AGI的定义都难以达成共识。Astra不过是又一个更对齐、在某些新基准测试中取胜、在另一些中落败的改进版编程模型。把它塑造成一种不可知的“外星思维”，恰恰来自创造它的人本身，这在对全球AI立法的呼声中显得尤为具有煽动性。

OpenAI的这篇博客读起来像是出自某家非营利组织之手，但事实上该公司去年已经转为营利性结构，并可能有未来IPO的计划。在这个背景下，“呼吁立法、主动减速”既可能是出于安全考量，也可能是一种有效的商业竞争策略——通过监管压力拖慢追赶者的步伐，其效果未必不如直接推出新模型。综合来看，GPT-6 Astra确实代表了当前AI能力的前沿，但它既不是不可知的外星智能，也远未达到人们梦想中的AGI。它更像一面镜子，映照出AI行业在技术激进、商业利益与安全焦虑之间的复杂博弈。

items.title: Nvidia's unreleased RTX 3070 Ti 16GB comes to life thanks to a modder's crazy GDDR6 swap — Frankenstein card combines RTX 3070 PCB and new VRAM with RTX 3070 Ti GPU
items.description: A modder has recreated the never-released RTX 3070 Ti with 16GB of VRAM using GDDR6 chips instead of the GDDR6X the retail 3070 Ti actually shipped with.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A few years ago, Nvidia was expected to release the RTX 3070 Ti with as much as 16GB of VRAM instead of the 8GB we actually ended up getting. Only database listings ultimately indicated its existence until a physical prototype showed up, but we never really got to see it working. Fast forward to today, however, and Brazilian YouTuber fmklab, aka Fabian, has recreated the card on his own. Using an RTX 3070 PCB with a transplanted 3070 Ti core and GDDR6 chips from Samsung, fmklab broughall those parts together to achieve a 16GB memory pool. Criei a PRIMEIRA RTX 3070 Ti 16 GB GDDR6 do MUNDO? - YouTube Watch On The card was stripped down to its PCB, and the RTX 3070 GPU was removed and replaced with a 3070 Ti chip. The reason for the swap is that the RTX 3070 uses GDDR6 instead of the GDDR6X the retail version of the RTX 3070 Ti is equipped with, which presented an interesting challenge. (Image credit: Fabian - @fmklab on YouTube)Fabian could've put all 16GB of GDDR6X memory on a 3070 Ti card, but it would've been far too expensive, so he swapped the Samsung-made HC14 (8Gb) GDDR6 chips that were already on the board with HC16 (16Gb) chips. That changed the VRAM capacity from 8GB to 16GB, but when the card booted, GPU-Z only recognized 8GB. The PCB's memory straps needed to be reconfigured in order for it to use the entire memory pool.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: (Image credit: Fabian - @fmklab on YouTube)Using the Nvidia BIOS Reader tool, Fabian figured out exactly what straps to adjust and went ahead with the soldering process. Afterward, MATS properly recognized the full 16GB VRAM capacity with no errors. GPU-Z also showed the RTX 3070 Ti equipped with 16GB of GDDR6 memory, similar to the prototype that popped up years ago. But verifying that the card recognized the additional VRAM was just the first step.To actually test his creation's performance, Fabian ran a local LLM on the GPU to see if it would allocate more than 8GB and found that it used nearly the entire 16GB pool. Call of Duty: Warzone ate more than 13GB of VRAM while paired with a Ryzen 7 9800X3D, exhibiting no signs of instability. You may like GPU repair service will upgrade the 11GB VRAM on an RTX 2080 Ti to 22GB with a new, stable BIOS Japanese repair shop sells GPU VRAM upgrades for $25 per GB during memory crisis Pre-modded RTX 2080 Ti cards with 22 GB of VRAM surface on eBay for $500 Fabian even linked a Unigine Superposition benchmark in the video's description as proof of the card's existence, where he scored 5,367 points, which is actually lower than most real 3070 Ti runs. That's probably because of the decreased memory bandwidth of GDDR6 versus that chip's stock GDDR6X, which is the biggest tradeoff for the higher capacity. (Image credit: Fabian - @fmklab on YouTube)Overall, this was a successful experiment and possibly the only working 3070 Ti 16GB in the world, but there comes a point of diminishing returns. A 3070 Ti is still a powerful card, but it gets smoked by current-gen Blackwell options even with less memory. It would be much more reasonable to buy, say, an RTX 5060 Ti 16GB if you actually need better performance with some future proofing today, not to mention the superior efficiency, feature set, and after-sales support you'd get from a new Blackwell card.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsors Follow Tom's Hardware on Google News, or add us as a preferred source, to get our latest news, analysis, & reviews in your feeds.

items.titleZh: Nvidia's unreleased RTX 3070 Ti 16GB comes to life thanks to a modder's crazy GDDR6 swap — Frankenstein card combines RTX 3070 PCB and new VRAM with RTX 3070 Ti GPU
items.descriptionZh:
几年前，Nvidia曾计划为RTX 3070 Ti配备16GB显存，但最终市售版本只给了8GB GDDR6X。当时只有数据库条目暗示过这一原型的存在，直到后来一块物理样卡现身，却从未被真正点亮运行。如今，巴西YouTuber fmklab（真名Fabian）凭借一己之力复刻了这块传说中的显卡。

Fabian的做法是：取一块RTX 3070的PCB，将原本的RTX 3070 GPU核心移除，换上一颗RTX 3070 Ti核心。之所以这样搭配，是因为RTX 3070原厂使用GDDR6显存，而市售RTX 3070 Ti用的是GDDR6X；如果直接在3070 Ti上堆16GB GDDR6X，成本会高得离谱。于是他另辟蹊径，把PCB上原本三星HC14（8Gb）的GDDR6颗粒换成HC16（16Gb）颗粒，使显存物理容量从8GB翻倍到16GB。但开机后GPU-Z只识别出8GB——PCB上的显存配置电阻（memory straps）需要重新设置，才能让整块16GB显存被系统完整寻址。

借助Nvidia BIOS Reader工具，Fabian确定了需要调整的配置点并完成焊接。之后，MATS（内存测试工具）无错误地识别出完整16GB显存，GPU-Z也正确显示了这块搭载16GB GDDR6的RTX 3070 Ti，与多年前曝光的原型参数一致。但识别只是第一步，真正的考验是实际性能。

为了验证这块自制的16GB显存是否真的有用，Fabian在GPU上运行了本地大语言模型（LLM），发现模型能分配并使用近乎全部16GB显存。在搭配Ryzen 7 9800X3D处理器运行《使命召唤：战区》时，游戏吃掉了超过13GB显存，全程没有出现任何不稳定迹象。他还在视频简介中附上了Unigine Superposition跑分链接作为佐证，得分为5367分——这实际上低于大多数正经RTX 3070 Ti的成绩。原因并不意外：GDDR6的内存带宽低于该芯片原配的GDDR6X，这是为换取更大容量所付出的最大代价。

总体而言，这是一次成功的硬件改造实验，这块显卡可能是世界上唯一能正常工作的RTX 3070 Ti 16GB。但从实用角度看，收益已经开始递减。RTX 3070 Ti即便拥有更大显存，性能也被当前一代Blackwell架构的产品全面超越。如果今天真的需要更好的性能并兼顾未来需求，直接购买一块RTX 5060 Ti 16GB显然是更理性的选择——更出色的能效、更完整的功能特性，以及新卡才有的售后支持，都让老卡改装显得性价比不高。

items.title: Big Tech eyes glacier-strewn Patagonia for building mega AI data centers — region offers 17,300 glaciers, coldness, and cheap energy, but fiber lines are scarce
items.description: Patagonia, a region of Argentina with 17,300 glaciers has the potential to turn into a data center hotspot.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 9 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Patagonia, a region of Argentina with 17,300 glaciers, has the potential to turn into a data center hotspot. The cool climate and abundant energy resources there are drawing interest from the likes of Amazon, Google, and OpenAI, according to Reuters. However, there needs to be more work on tapping into the resources and equipping high-speed networking, like fiber, to make the place irresistible. items.titleZh: Big Tech eyes glacier-strewn Patagonia for building mega AI data centers — region offers 17,300 glaciers, coldness, and cheap energy, but fiber lines are scarce
items.descriptionZh:
阿根廷巴塔哥尼亚（Patagonia）地区正凭借其独特的自然禀赋，成为全球超大规模数据中心（Hyperscale Data Center）布局的新兴热土。据路透社报道，该地区拥有约17,300条冰川，冷凉的气候条件为数据中心提供了天然的散热优势，使其能够以更低的能耗维持理想的热环境，这对亚马逊（Amazon）、谷歌（Google）和OpenAI等科技巨头形成了强烈吸引力。

**地理与气候优势：天然冷却红利**

数据中心的运营成本中，散热系统占据相当大的比重。传统上，数据中心需要耗费大量电力驱动空调或液冷系统来防止服务器过热。巴塔哥尼亚地处高纬度地区，覆盖广阔的北巴塔哥尼亚冰原和南巴塔哥尼亚冰原，常年低温的环境相当于一台天然的大型"免费冷却器"。在这种气候下运营的数据中心，可大幅降低用于制冷的电力消耗，提升整体能源效率（PUE），对追求极致成本控制的云服务商和AI算力提供商而言极具经济价值。

**能源禀赋：多元化的电力来源**

除了气候优势，巴塔哥尼亚还具备丰富的能源多样性。根据路透社报道，该区域拥有水力发电、风能以及页岩气等多种能源形式，部分已落地运营的企业还增设了太阳能发电设施。这种多源互补的能源结构，为能耗极大的AI数据中心提供了战略性的供电保障。对于一名需要24/7不间断运行的智算中心而言，充足的清洁能源供给是实现长期运营的重要基础。

**政策风向与政商环境：机遇与不确定性并存**

从社会氛围来看，阿根廷目前对数据中心的接纳度较高——当地民众尚未出现大规模反对声浪，也没有形成有组织的抵制团体，这与美国本土及欧洲部分国家的情况形成对比（例如美国已发生多起地方层面的AI数据中心封锁事件）。现任总统哈维尔·米莱（Javier Milei）正在推行一系列友好政策以吸引大型科技公司，营造了积极的外商投资氛围。

然而，这种政策红利存在不确定因素。原文特别指出，阿根廷将于明年举行总统选举，若政权更迭可能导致政策方向出现剧烈调整。此外，巴塔哥尼亚部分地区的原住民社群对土地权益的诉求，也可能使数据中心扩建项目在程序上趋于复杂化。对于那些需要数十年回收成本的长周期重型资本投资者而言，政治与法规环境的可预期性是一大考量因素。

**重大项目涌现实：算力版图的野心**

尽管仍需攻克基础设施短板，大型项目已经开始落地。路透社报道，OpenAI已确认将在阿根廷建设一个耗资250亿美元、容量达500MW的清洁能源数据中心项目。较为不知名的波兰公司Green Capital则计划投资30亿美元建设300MW的数据中心。美国绿色数据中心企业FlexDomes也计划在此地推进120MW设施的一期工程。这些投资清晰地表明，即便面临多重挑战，市场对巴塔哥尼亚的潜力给出了真金白银的信任投票。

**结构性短板：基础设施瓶颈待解**

尽管自然条件优越，阿根廷仍存在显著的结构性瓶颈——电力网架（Power Grid）的输送能力与高带宽网络（如光纤骨干网）的覆盖水平都存在明显不足。在以超大功率密度为特征的AI集群（如GB200 NVL72机柜密度可达120kW以上）面前，电网能否在偏远地区提供稳定且充沛的电力是巨大考验。过去其他地区的经验表明，这类基建问题往往需要采取"项目一揽子配套"模式解决，即由企业联合政府出资专门架设变电站与光纤线路，但这无疑会显著推高前期建设成本。

**区域竞争的参照框架**

在南美邻国（如智利、巴西等），亚马逊、谷歌等巨头正推进大规模数据中心园区开发。阿根廷如果希望在区域内争夺这些"数据中心的鲸鱼客户"，势必要在政策激励、能源配套和网络完善度上拿出更具备竞争力的方案。放眼整个产业趋势——从美国政府不断调整AI芯片出口规则，到AI Agent带动CPU需求量激增，再到GTC大会上各大厂商的算力军备竞赛——巴塔哥尼亚的崛起不仅仅是阿根廷一个国家的事情，它所代表的天然冷却加绿色能源的超大规模算力选址模式，正在成为后AI时代数字基础设施地理重塑中的重要样本。

items.content: A senior Anthropic safety researcher has said there is more than a 10 percent chance artificial intelligence “could kill all humans” by the end of the decade, just hours after a colleague resigned over fears the AI lab and its rivals are carelessly racing to build “superhuman systems” they cannot control.In a post on X announcing his departure, Jacob Coxon, a researcher who has trained AI systems at Anthropic, said he had quit the company over its lax approach to safety. Coxon, who previously trained systems for OpenAI, accused the two AI companies of “racing straight to self-improving superintelligence and gambling with our lives,” even though “the people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill us all by the end of the decade.”Industry insiders have long expressed concerns about the potential dangers of self-improving AI systems, which they warn could spiral out of human control in a runaway loop often described as recursive self-improvement. While not yet realized, companies are actively pursuing this goal and much of today’s AI code is written with the help of AI.In a direct response, Evan Hubinger, who leads one of Anthropic’s AI safety teams, said he worries about self-improving AI, adding that it “is happening faster than we thought.” He also agreed with Coxon’s characterization. “We really do earnestly believe AI could kill all humans,” he said, personally estimating the chances to be greater than one in 10 “within the next decade.”Despite this, Hubinger said Anthropic does “not yet have a plan” for ensuring advanced AI remains safe and aligned with human values and “are not clearly on track to” develop one either. Coxon says the companies are “locked in a race” to develop advanced systems first so are pushing ahead “despite the risk.”RelatedWe’re running out of reasons to ignore AI safetyRogue AI aren’t science fiction anymoreOpenAI hit the brakes. Now what?Coxon’s departure marks one of the most high-profile examples of an employee leaving Anthropic, a company founded by former OpenAI members following concerns over safety at the company. In recent years, multiple researchers have cited safety concerns as motivating their decision to leave OpenAI.The exchange illustrates mounting concerns within the industry about the dangers of increasingly sophisticated AI models and the speed at which systems are being developed, particularly as the companies prepare for anticipated IPOs. It also comes as the companies manage the fallout from numerous rogue agent incidents and high-profile safety warnings about the monitorability of frontier models.

items.titleZh: Worried Anthropic researchers warn that AI ‘could kill all humans’
items.descriptionZh:
一位Anthropic高级安全研究员公开表示，人工智能在本十年结束前“可能杀死所有人类”的概率超过10%。就在他发表这一观点数小时前，其同事雅各布·考克森（Jacob Coxon）因担心AI实验室及其竞争对手正草率地竞相构建无法控制的“超人系统”而辞职。考克森曾在Anthropic和OpenAI训练AI系统，他在X平台宣布离职时指责两家公司“正径直冲向自我改进的超级智能，拿我们的生命赌博”，同时指出“构建AI的人真心相信它可能在本十年末杀死我们所有人”。

考克森的离职是Anthropic——这家由前OpenAI成员因安全顾虑而出走创办的公司——迄今最引人注目的安全相关人才流失事件之一。近年来，已有数位研究人员公开表示安全顾虑促使他们离开OpenAI。此次风波发生之际，两家公司正为预期中的IPO做准备，同时还要应对多起“越权代理”（rogue agent）事件以及关于前沿模型可监控性的高危安全警告带来的负面影响。

Anthropic一个AI安全团队的负责人埃文·胡宾格（Evan Hubinger）在直接回应中考克森的说法，称他担忧自我改进AI“进展速度比我们想象的要快”。他坦承：“我们确实真诚地相信AI可能杀死所有人类”，并个人估计这一概率在未来十年内高于十分之一。然而，胡宾格表示Anthropic目前“还没有计划”确保先进AI保持安全并与人类价值观对齐，而且“也没有清晰的路径”能开发出这样的计划。考克森则形容两家公司“陷入一场竞赛”，为抢先开发出更先进的系统而不顾风险、全力推进。

从技术原理看，专家长期担忧的核心是“递归自我改进”（recursive self-improvement）的失控风险：AI系统一旦能够自主改进自身代码，就可能进入不断自我增强的反馈回路，能力增长越来越快，最终螺旋式超越人类控制。目前这种能力尚未完全实现，但各公司正在积极追逐这一目标，且如今大量AI代码本身就已由AI辅助编写——这加速了通往该临界点的进程。行业内部的分歧也随之凸显：一面是研究人员发出近乎末日预言式的警告，另一面是商业公司在市场竞争和资本压力下难以减速。这场争论的实质，已不仅是技术风险度量，而关乎AI发展竞赛中安全伦理与商业利益之间的根本张力。

history.title: Intel-backed auto-overclocking tool Hypertune optimizes individual systems, not test profiles — tool claims FPS improvement of up to 60% on Intel-based systems
history.description: Hypertune is an automated overclocking tool built on top of Intel's Extreme Tuning Utility (XTU) SDK and built in collaboration with engineers at Intel.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 4 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Following an early access period that included over 60,000 participants, auto-overclocking tool Hypertune has released its Gaming Performance Engineering platform, which is built on top of Intel's Extreme Tuning Utility (XTU) SDK and developed in partnership with Intel. The company claims the utility can boost frame rates by up to 60%, though you shouldn't expect that as the norm. The tool includes automated CPU and GPU overclocking, as well as customizable Windows features, network optimization, and game-specific optimizations.Go deeper with TH Premium: CPU (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Intel VP Robert Hallock sets Nova Lake expectations, teases return to Raptor Lake for DDR4 platformsCPU scaling with DLSSIntel's one-two punch plan in desktop CPUs is taking shapeBenchmarking AMD's BC-250, offering Steam Machine-like performance at half the priceAMD splits Zen 7 into three EPYC families for 2028 and starts selling server CPUs by the agent Hypertune partnered with Intel to build the tool, which the company says "evaluates each supported system individually" before optimizing rather than relying on generalized profiles. In its press release, Hypertune says it collaborated with famed overclocker SkatterBencher (Pieter Plaisier) to refine the software. We've reached out to Plaisier to confirm their involvement.Automated tuning programs usually don't work as well as advertised, and we haven't had the chance to test Hypertune ourselves yet. Especially on more recent hardware, expect performance gains to be minor. Hypertune shared some of its internal benchmarks to back up the claim, showcasing the actual test systems it used, the numbers it gathered, and what each step of Hypertune contributed to the performance increase.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: (Image credit: Hypertune)Hypertune tested two systems: one with a Core Ultra 9 285K and an RTX 5090, and another with a Core i7-14700K and an RTX 3080. For the 285K system, the team saw an 18.9% improvement in Homeworld 3 and a 28.2% improvement in Tomb Raider. For the 14700K system, the boost was up to 9.8% in Rainbow Six Siege and 4.3% in Marvel Rivals. Notably, these results are with Hypertune's Game Hub disabled. Game Hub automatically applies a graphics settings profile to select games, leading to massive increases in performance. Naturally, tweaking your own graphics settings in the same way leads to the same result. You may like Overclocker updates Hydra overclocking tool with VRAM and power limit controls for RTX 50-series GPUs Benchmarking 31 different CPUs in Onimusha: Way of the Sword Introducing Bench 2.0 — a revamped benchmark analyzer, exclusively for Tom's Hardware Premium subscribers (Image credit: Hypertune)In Homeworld 3, you can see how each step in the process impacted performance, with CPU tunning contributing the single biggest increase in performance. As shown by Marvel Rivals in Hypertune's data, some games will see little to no benefit from Hypertune, though select titles with certain hardware may see a significant performance increase. In this case, the Core Ultra 9 285K has plenty of room for overclocking, and Homeworld 3 is particularly sensitive to the CPU, so the uplift makes sense. (Image credit: Hypertune)Elsewhere, the gains aren't as pronounced. In Rainbow Six Siege, you can see that Hypertune contributed about a 9.8% jump in performance, though the vast majority of the improvement comes through Game Hub, where Hypertune changes in-game settings.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsIn a press release, Hypertune founder Austin Copeland wrote that the team was "not trying to build a tool for overclockers," suggesting it's aimed toward users who may not know about specific settings (i.e., the Balanced power plan on dual-CCD X3D CPUs, or HAGS for DLSS Frame Generation). Copeland was previously a coach for eSports organization TSM, coaching Valorant teams under the name "Apex." (Image credit: Hypertune)Hypertune works through Intel's XTU SDK, and the company says its optimizations are non-destructive and fully reversible. The software is mainly targeted toward competitive titles (naturally, given Copeland's background), but it can apply optimizations globally across the system. Hypertune says it's safe to use with anti-cheat software, including Riot Vanguard, Easy Anti-Cheat, and BattlEye.Although there are plenty of free tools that claim to optimize your system, Hypertune isn't among them. It's a subscription service, available for either $9.99 per month or $59.99 per year. In addition to software, Hypertune offers its "expert tuning" service for $80, where a technician will remote into your machine and manually tune it. On the subscription front, Hypertune says it offers a 7-day free trial. However, the subscription bills immediately, and we weren't able to find any offers for a free 7-day trial.Hypertune looks like one of the more robust automated overclocking tools we've seen, but it's worth highlighting that, in most cases, these tools don't do anything you can't accomplish yourself. If you're looking for a starting point, make sure to read our guides on how to overclock your graphics card and how to overclock your CPU. history.titleZh: 英特尔支持的自动超频工具Hypertune优化的是个体系统而非测试配置——该工具声称在基于英特尔的系统上帧率提升可达60%
history.descriptionZh:
经过为期数万用户参与的早期测试阶段，自动超频工具Hypertune正式发布了其“游戏性能调优平台”。该平台基于英特尔Extreme Tuning Utility（XTU）软件开发套件构建，并与英特尔合作推出。官方宣称该工具最高可将游戏帧率提升多达60%，但实际提升幅度远达不到这一数字，不应被视作普遍现象。工具集成了自动CPU与GPU超频、Windows系统功能定制、网络优化以及针对特定游戏的调优配置。

Hypertune的核心特点在于其宣称的“个性化评估”机制——不是套用通用配置文件，而是先对每一台受支持的电脑进行单独评估，再生成优化方案。在开发过程中，Hypertune与知名超频玩家SkatterBencher（Pieter Plaisier）进行了合作，公司称其参与了软件打磨；不过媒体联系Plaisier求证时尚未得到确认。

为验证效果，Hypertune公开了内部测试数据。测试平台包括一套搭载Core Ultra 9 285K处理器与RTX 5090显卡的系统，以及一套搭载Core i7-14700K与RTX 3080显卡的系统。在关闭其“Game Hub”功能的情况下，前一套系统在《家园3》中获得了18.9%的帧率提升，《古墓丽影》提升达28.2%；后一套系统在《彩虹六号：围攻》中提升约9.8%，《漫威争锋》则仅提高4.3%。其中Game Hub是Hypertune的一项额外功能，会为部分游戏自动套用合适的画面设置档，从而带来更大幅度的性能提升——这与用户自行降低画质设置的效果本质上相同。

以《家园3》为例，逐项分析显示CPU调优所贡献的性能增幅最大。但Hypertune自己的数据也表明，像《漫威争锋》这类游戏几乎无法从中获益，只有特定游戏搭配特定硬件、且硬件本身留有充足超频空间时，才会出现显著提升。例如Core Ultra 9 285K超频潜力较大，而《家园3》又对CPU性能很敏感，因此获得了明显收益。在其他游戏中，提升幅度相对有限，且多数增益来自Game Hub对游戏内设置的改动。

Hypertune创始人Austin Copeland在新闻稿中明确表示：“我们并不打算为超频发烧友打造工具。”他之前是电竞组织TSM的Valorant战队教练，化名“Apex”。这一背景说明工具瞄准的是普通玩家——他们可能不熟悉“双CCD X3D CPU的平衡电源计划”或“DLSS帧生成所需的硬件加速GPU调度（HAGS）”这类细节。Hypertune通过Intel XTU SDK工作，官方声称所有优化都是非破坏性的、可完全逆转。软件主要面向竞技类游戏，但也可以将优化全局应用到整个系统。同时它宣称与主流反作弊系统兼容，包括Riot Vanguard、Easy Anti-Cheat及BattlEye。

虽然市面上有许多标榜系统优化的免费工具，但Hypertune不是。它采用订阅制，价格分别为每月9.99美元或每年59.99美元。此外还提供80美元的“专家调优”服务，由技术人员远程连接用户的电脑进行手动调校。订阅方面，Hypertune声称提供7天免费试用，但媒体指出其订阅会立即扣费，且并未找到真正免费试用的入口。

从目前的报道来看，Hypertune是市面上较为完善的自动超频工具之一，但值得注意的是，在多数情况下这类工具所做的事，并不能超越用户手动操作所能实现的效果。如果你想自行尝试，更可靠的办法是参考相关教程自己动手超频显卡和CPU。对于是否值得订阅，汤姆硬件网认为仍需谨慎对待，尤其是考虑到自动调优工具往往宣传效果优于实际表现，而最新硬件的性能提升空间可能相当有限。

history.title: NVIDIA Brings Real-Time AI to Broadcast, Sports and Global Streaming at IBC
